authenticity_review: The image exhibits high visual fidelity in terms of lighting and texture rendering, but suffers from specific structural artifacts typical of AI generation. Notably, the yellow bear on the right shows fusion where the cupcake on its head melts indistinctly into the fur. The brown bear head on the bottom right sits on a star-shaped cookie body with an anatomically impossible and undefined connection point. Additionally, the white icing dollops on the main donut lack realistic viscosity, appearing solid like clay. While the overall composition is coherent, these local structural failures reduce authenticity.
